entities.name: Atog
entities.description: Small scavenging creatures with insatiable appetites, most common on Dominaria.

entities.name: Atogatog
entities.description: A unique atog lord of great size and power on Otaria that fed upon its kind.

entities.name: Megatog
entities.description: Gigantic atog offshoot found only on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Chronatog
entities.description: Mysterious Jamuran atog that feeds on time.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where atogs are most common.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Dominarian continent with the largest variety of atogs.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Metallic plane where atogs became alpha predators.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in whose wake atogs flourished in Otaria.

events.summary: Some atogs are transported from Dominaria to Mirrodin where they become alpha predators.
events.quote: Some atogs were transported from Dominaria to the metallic plane of Mirrodin
